description: Type buckets.setIamPolicy's HTTP 412 for a stale policy etag. Cloud Storage answers a concurrent read-modify-write with 412 PRECONDITION FAILED ('At least one of the pre-conditions you specified did not hold.') instead of the 409 ABORTED other IAM APIs use; 412 is not in the core status map, so it landed as UnknownGCPError. A dedicated tag lets callers re-read the policy and retry.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The policy's etag no longer matches the bucket's current IAM policy — another writer changed it concurrently (HTTP 412). Re-read the policy and retry.
